distribution.narrative: Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) reports Jiangsu under the historical source usage Orthotomicus nankinensis Fabricius, 1792. Its equivalence to the currently accepted Orthotomicus nankinensis Kurentsov & Kononov, 1966 is unresolved. This source report does not confirm mainland occurrence; Candidate and In review remain unchanged.
